It uses a frozen LLM backbone with acoustic + semantic tokenizers at 7.5 Hz and a diffusion head to produce up to 90 minutes of conversational audio with up to 4 speakers in a single pass. paragraphs: Joint video and synchronized sound from MiniMax-H3, rebuilt for a single 96 GB Blackwell ZeroGPU worker.

MiniMax-H3's published model card notes that about 13B parameters live in AdaLN-related branches and that their outputs can be precomputed for inference. The pruned checkpoint makes that concrete: it samples the shared timestep embedding curve at 1025 points and linearly interpolates an 8-value coordinate for each requested timestep. Every block's modulation projection consequently becomes [96768, 8] instead of [96768, 2688].

The four large matrices in each of the 50 blocks—fused QKV, attention output, MLP up/gate and MLP down—are NVFP4. The modulation curve, norms, embeddings, biases and final heads stay at higher precision.

repositories.name: FinSense RL
repositories.description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: FinSense is a goal-driven financial decision-making RL environment simulating Indian household budgeting. Given a savings goal (e.g. buying a phone worth ₹20,000), a monthly salary, and daily expenses, an AI agent learns to decide which expenses to allow, reduce, or avoid — balancing stress, risk, and deadlines to hit the target in time.

FinSense simulates real-world Indian household financial decision-making. An AI agent manages daily expenses across a fixed-horizon episode, deciding to allow, reduce, or avoid each incoming expense — balancing a savings goal, stress accumulation, and stochastic income shocks.

Unlike toy environments, FinSense models a task that millions of Indians face every month: a fixed salary, unpredictable expenses, and a savings goal that keeps slipping. The environment captures delayed consequences (avoiding food today increases stress), trade-offs (essential vs discretionary spending), and temporal pressure (required savings per day increases as the deadline approaches).
features: Expense categories include Swiggy, Zomato, BESCOM electricity, auto rickshaw, EMI payments
Amounts are in INR and reflect realistic Indian price ranges
The stress mechanic prevents the trivial "avoid everything" exploit — avoiding essential expenses like rent or medicine increases stress, which penalises the agent
The dailyallowance field tells the agent exactly how much it can spend today and still hit the savings goal

repositories.name: CADENA Stepwise CAD
repositories.description: Turn a 3D mesh into a parametric CadQuery program

paragraphs: Gradio demo for CADENA — a Qwen2-VL-2B policy that reverse-engineers a 3D mesh into a parametric CadQuery program, one operation at a time.

At each step the target mesh and the solid built so far are rendered into an eight-view collage (six axis-aligned orthographic views whose brightness encodes depth, plus two isometric views). The target occupies the green channel and the geometry built so far the red one, so what the policy reads is the residual. It emits the next CAD operation, the partial program is executed with OpenCASCADE, volumetric IoU against the target is measured, and the step is kept only if IoU improved.
The rollout mirrors inference/cadworker.py from zhemdi/cadena, with vLLM serving replaced by a local transformers generate call so it fits a single ZeroGPU slot.

paragraphs: This Space runs the public neonforestmist/Clover-Image-Tiny and neonforestmist/Clover-Image-Tiny-Inpaint models with Hugging Face ZeroGPU. Use the Mode control to switch between Regular text-to-image generation and masked Inpainting. Both exact model revisions are pinned in app.py for reproducibility.

The Diffusers pipeline is loaded once in float16 and placed on ZeroGPU's emulated CUDA device at module scope, following the ZeroGPU runtime contract. Its quality-oriented default is 50-step PNDM; 51-100 is an exploratory range that runs slower and is not guaranteed to improve an image. These controls are conventional Diffusers scheduler iterations. Prompt, negative prompt, seed, CFG,…

paragraphs: A Gradio Workflow (node-based canvas) that turns one photo into a 360° camera orbit video with the scene held still — with the denoiser inlined into this Space: the orbit operator node is a bound Python function (orbit in orbit.py, adapted from pablodawson/minimax-h3-360-orbit) decorated with @spaces.GPU, so runs execute on this Space's own ZeroGPU hardware, not through a gradio client call to the upstream Space.

The canvas wires a Photo to orbit reference (prefilled with an example) into the orbit function node and out to two subjects: the Orbit Video and the Run Report. One remote call remains by design: the 62 GiB Qwen3-VL conditioner half of the split MiniMax-H3 deployment still runs in multimodalart/qwen3vl-conditioner and is called over the gradio API per request — MiniMax-H3's two halves cannot share one Space's storage quota. Everything else (the pruned transformer partition, both VAEs, the orbit LoRA) loads and runs here.

Users can upload images via drag-and-drop or file input, clear their workspace, and submit prompts to the AI for various image generation and editing tasks, with error handling for a smooth experience.

The frontend is developed using React, providing a dynamic component-based architecture for building the user interface. For styling, it uses Tailwind CSS, which offers a utility-first approach and ensures responsive, clean, and consistent design using classes like p-2, flex, rounded-full, and shadow. To enhance the visual interface, Lucide React is used for incorporating scalable SVG icons such as ChevronDown, Library, LoaderCircle, and others, adding clarity and…

On the backend and AI side, the application integrates the Google Gemini API (@google/genai), specifically leveraging the gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview model for image generation and manipulation tasks. It securely manages API keys through environment variables (process.env.APIKEY), ensuring sensitive data is not exposed. Additionally, the project implements native Canvas API for drawing and image manipulation functionalities within the Canvas mode, while FileReader and DOM events are used to handle file uploads through drag-and-drop or input-based interactions, enabling smooth media…

repositories.description: Prompt-free all-in-one restoration (rain/haze/blur/noise)

paragraphs: Demo of ImIR (arXiv:2609.25267, ACCV 2026) — a task-agnostic, prompt-free all-in-one image restoration model. Drop in a degraded image (rain, haze, blur, noise, low light, JPEG artifacts, or a mix) and ImIR restores it from the image alone: no text prompt, no degradation label.
ImIR adapts Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 with a LoRA plus a lightweight token mapper that converts the degraded image's own vision-language embedding into a continuous restoration instruction.

The Space runs the authors' reference inference path (latent packing, flow schedule, and 30-step flow-matching sampler) on ZeroGPU. Images are processed at up to 1 MP and returned at the original resolution.
